headline: Pabna: School teacher killed after intruders break into home
summary: The body of 45-year-old Gita Rani was found in a toilet tank near her house in Atgharia, Pabna, on Thursday morning.
details: Police recovered the body of a school teacher from a toilet tank next to her home in Atgharia, Pabna, on Thursday morning.
The deceased, identified as 45-year-old Gita Rani, was a teacher at Chakiya BRAC School and the wife of Nanda Das from Ekdanta Baripara village.
According to police and locals, intruders broke into the house around 3:00 AM. Gita Rani reportedly struggled with the intruders before being strangled to death.
The attackers then dumped her body into a nearby abandoned toilet tank. Locals discovered the body around 11:00 AM during a search.
Atgharia Police Station Officer-in-Charge Nazmul Haque confirmed the incident and stated that the body has been sent to Pabna General Hospital morgue for autopsy.
Police are currently investigating the case to identify the perpetrators and determine the motive behind the killing.
caption:
A school teacher was strangled to death and dumped in a toilet tank after intruders broke into her home in Pabna.

Police recovered the body of a school teacher from a toilet tank next to her home in Atgharia, Pabna, on Thursday morning.

The deceased, identified as 45-year-old Gita Rani, was a teacher at Chakiya BRAC School and the wife of Nanda Das from Ekdanta Baripara village.

According to police and locals, intruders broke into the house around 3:00 AM. Gita Rani reportedly struggled with the intruders before being strangled to death.

The attackers then dumped her body into a nearby abandoned toilet tank. Locals discovered the body around 11:00 AM during a search.

Atgharia Police Station Officer-in-Charge Nazmul Haque confirmed the incident and stated that the body has been sent to Pabna General Hospital morgue for autopsy.

Police are currently investigating the case to identify the perpetrators and determine the motive behind the killing.

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: [[10 women accuse actor]] Jared Leto of sexual misconduct; allegations span years
headline: 10 women accuse actor Jared Leto of sexual misconduct; allegations span years
summary: A new BBC documentary reveals accusations from 10 women, some of whom were minors at the time of the alleged incidents. Leto denies all claims.
details: Oscar-winning actor and musician Jared Leto is facing renewed allegations of serious sexual misconduct. A new BBC documentary, 'Jared Leto: Hollywood's Dark Secret,' features accusations from a total of 10 women, with nine speaking out publicly for the first time.

Four women detailed allegations in the documentary that could be considered crimes under US law. These alleged incidents reportedly occurred when the women were teenagers and Leto was in his 30s and 40s. The actor has vehemently denied all accusations through a spokesperson, stating, 'I have never engaged in any sexual misconduct. These allegations are entirely and unequivocally false.'

One accuser alleges that Leto sexually assaulted her in a motel bathroom when she was 17. Another claims Leto threatened her with sexual violence at age 19. A third woman alleges a sexual relationship with Leto in California when she was 17, noting that the state's legal age of consent was 18 at the time, and that Leto dismissed her concerns.

A fourth woman reported receiving multiple sexually suggestive phone calls from Leto when she was 16, and that he proposed a sexual encounter at least once. The BBC claims this woman possessed a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) that would have prevented her from discussing her relationship with Leto publicly, but she refused to sign it. Four other women alleged that Leto engaged in 'unusual' and 'highly sexually suggestive' phone conversations with them when they were young.

The BBC states it corroborated some accusers' accounts with their then-friends and family members, and reviewed photos and messages in some cases to support their claims. Former employees of Leto's band also spoke out, expressing discomfort with his interactions with young fans and alleging they were sometimes invited to backstage areas, dressing rooms, or recording houses.

This is not the first time Leto has faced such accusations. Last year, Los Angeles DJ Ally Mays publicly accused Leto of sexual misconduct when she was 17. Several others have since come forward with similar allegations. A June 2025 Air Mail report detailed accusations of inappropriate behavior against Leto by nine women over several years, all of which the actor also denied.
